description:
Old Ways Restored explains the frugal, self-reliant home methods that quietly fell out of everyday life — passive cooling and heating, food kept without modern systems, water, and old-house repair.

Every video starts in the primary sources: U.S. Department of Energy and national-laboratory research, USDA and EPA guidance, and period building references. 

I read those, work out what the method actually delivers and where it fails, price it at current US rates, and put the limits on screen.

The research, scripting, structure and editorial judgement are mine. Production uses AI narration and a mix of AI-generated and licensed stock visuals; every video carries YouTube's altered-or-synthetic-content disclosure.

Nothing here was banned or hidden — it was just untaught.

These are general-education explainers, not professional advice — confirm with a qualified professional for your specific home before acting.

New video every week.
